description: This file defines extension methods for the MemoryPool<byte> class, providing functionality to compute minimum segment and allocation sizes based on the pool's properties.

classes.name: MemoryPoolExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for MemoryPool<byte> to calculate minimum segment and allocation sizes.

methods.name: GetMinimumSegmentSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum segment size for the given MemoryPool, defaulting to 4096 if the pool is null, or the minimum of 4096 and the pool's MaxBufferSize.

methods.name: GetMinimumAllocSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum allocation size as half of the minimum segment size.
